environment.valkey: three-node Valkey 8.1 Cluster; all three primary containers were stopped

contract.expected: Liveness remains available, readiness becomes not_ready after the sustained dual-dependency partition, and authenticated Virtual Key traffic is rejected while the persistence snapshot is not ready.

precondition.interpretation: The key was accepted through authentication and rejected only because no matching route existed; no upstream provider was contacted.

environment_recovery.limitation: The original PostgreSQL container used an ephemeral writable layer. Stopping it removed the container and its test database. This invalidated the pre-partition key and test data; it is a QA infrastructure durability/setup loss, not evidence of a Tanpopo storage defect.
environment_recovery.recovery: Created a replacement isolated PostgreSQL 16 container and a non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS application login; provisioned only the documented NOLOGIN webhook-worker role and narrow grants. Restarted the same exact-source binary against fresh PostgreSQL plus a recovered 3-node Valkey cluster. Completed a real Chromium first-install flow and inspected the Owner form, review, Overview, and Operations screenshots. The three runtime roles returned /readyz HTTP 200 and Operations showed PostgreSQL, config epoch 1, and 3 healthy process nodes.
not_demonstrated: restoration of the removed database or its test data
post-recovery replay of the now-invalid pre-partition Virtual Key

coverage.database_container_replacement_durabilit: UNVERIFIED (test infrastructure had no persistent volume)
